title: wg: draft-barnes-mimi-identity-arch-04 editorial: [RFC633] should be RFC 7633; status-list ref is informative; typos
description: From assay .44.51. L480/L804: [RFC633] is a 1974 IMP/TIP maintenance RFC; the TLS Feature extension is RFC 7633. L735: I-D.ietf-oauth-status-list is Normative but used only as an example (L522) in an Informational draft: move to Informative. Typos: communcations (L19, L121), cryptographcally (L236), identifers (L237). Held per Mark 2026-11-16 (hold all spec feedback).
